verdict.rationale: Carta has no CLI or runner, but its REST API supports headless machine-to-machine automation. The OAuth CLIENT_CREDENTIALS flow needs no interactive user consent, service accounts can access Investor API data, and the playground environment returns static, valid responses without real credentials, which suits CI tests. You must hand-roll scripts against the API. Missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK, CI-specific guidance or examples, a published OpenAPI spec (all probe paths 404), and independent corroboration of headless use.
